newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Highlands sees 20 pct of stock traded.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Highlands sees 20 pct of stock traded.

text.p: About 20 percent of the issued capital in Papua New Guinea gold miner Highlands Gold Ltd was traded on Wednesday, the bulk of it moved after the close of trading at a price of 75 cents per share.
Dealers said a number of parcels totalling about 113.9 million Highlands shares were bought through broker Macquarie Equities Ltd after the close of trade at a price of 75 cents.
"I think it is Placer (Pacific Ltd) buying. I was told they wanted 160 million (shares)," one Sydney-based institutional dealer said.
A spokesman from Macquarie Equities said he could not discuss the transaction while a Highlands spokeman was unavailable for comment.

Highlands' major asset is its 25 percent stake in the one million ounce a year Porgera gold mine in Papua New Guinea (PNG). Placer Pacific Ltd also owns 25 percent of Porgera and is the mine's manager.
The remainder is split equally between Goldfields Ltd and the recently floated holding company for the PNG government's resource assets, Orogen Minerals Ltd.
Takeover rumours for Highlands started in April when MIM Holdings Ltd decided to offload its 65 percent stake in the company at 65 cents per share.
